bibman_core_library_notes: v19: the bookmarklet's form opens in its own window, served by the Capture web app, so it works on sites that refuse a page's requests to BibMan (SciX). In each web app: Libraries → BibManCore → select version 19, then Deploy → Manage deployments → Edit → New version
bibman_frontend_thinclient_webapp_notes: v22: Code.gs's settings function is private (it could be called from the dashboard's page and returned every Script Property). Replace Code.gs, select Core 19, set FRONTEND_THINCLIENT_VERSION to 22, and redeploy
bibman_bookmarklet_capture_webapp_notes: v18: serves the bookmarklet's window (needs Core 19); its settings function is private and its editor functions run only for the owner. Replace Code.gs, select Core 19, set BOOKMARKLET_CAPTURE_VERSION to 18, and redeploy
bibman_bookmarklet_notes: opens in its own window, so it works on SciX and other sites with strict security rules
